# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary

The supplied transcript dump contains several hundred "calls," but the overwhelming majority are **not usable sales conversations**: long stretches are internal logistics chatter (MTC/tag/seal paperwork, truck loading, driver coordination, coil-cutting operator instructions to "Yuvraj Operator," payment-charge disputes), voicemails, wrong numbers, and multiple long personal/Hindi-Gujarati conversations (the "Vishal" calls) that have nothing to do with steel sales. After filtering, there is a **genuine but modest set of real sales calls** — dealer/distributor rate negotiations (Uniqcore, V R Earth Movers, Vinayaga Steel Pradeep, Vidveda, Vijaya Steels, Venkatesan, VJR Developers, V SRIDHAR/Sivakesava, Vijayalakshmi Builder, Vanniar/Aster, Yuvaraj Elumalai/Rani Engineering, Zetwork Harish, etc.). These calls are short, transactional, and repeat the same few moves: rate enquiry → stock/brand confirmation → discount push → payment/logistics close. Because the real sales content is thin and repetitive, this KB stays tightly grounded in what is actually said, and keeps generalizations conservative.

## Products & brand ladder

BSC sells a wide basket of **structural & flat steel products**, not roofing sheets. Across calls customers ask for:

- **TMT rebar** — grades **Fe 500, 500D, 550D**; brands discussed: **Vizag (RINL)**, **SAIL**, **Tata**, **JSW**. "500 கிடைக்காது sir... 500 வந்து வெறும் R&L தான் sir produce பண்ணுவாங்க" [500-grade is only made by RINL/Vizag now] — shows 550D is the more commonly available grade, true 500/500D is scarce.
- **MS Plates/Sheets** (checkered & plain) — thicknesses from 2mm–25mm+, standard sizes "2500 x 6300," "8x4," "4x8" feet. Brands: **Sail, Vaisakh, NMDC**.
- **Structural steel**: **ISMB, ISMC, SHS/RHS (square & rectangular hollow sections), L-angle, C-channel, I-channel, flats, round bars, M.S. round**.
- **Pipes**: round/square pipes — explicitly told "Apollo கிடைக்கும்... local make தான் இருக்கும்... Tata-ல கிடைக்கும் pipe" [Apollo and Tata available for pipe; rest only local make].
- **CRS (Corrosion Resistant Steel) TMT** — "sale TMT 500D தான் வருமா sir CRS-ல? ஆ CRS-ல 500D தான் sir வரும். 550 வராது."
- **Coils / cut-to-length sheet service** (coil cutting, plate cutting to custom lengths) is a regular add-on service.

**Brand ladder (as stated by reps):**
1. **Tata Steel** – premium, "rate ரொம்ப high-ஆ இருக்கும் ஆனா Tata-ல கிடைக்கும்" [rate very high but available].
2. **Vizag (RINL/Vaisakh) & SAIL** – the company's own main "sale" brand, used for most bulk structural/TMT supply.
3. **Apollo** – for pipes only, branded alternative to local make.
4. **Local/unbranded make** – cheapest, used when branded stock unavailable: "2.5-ல வேணும்னா local brand-ல கிடைக்கும்."

Price parity note: "Vaisakh-க்கும் sale-க்கும் difference இருக்கா rate-ல? Rate different இருக்காது sir. ரெண்டுமே same price தான்" — Sale and Vaisakh brands are priced identically; SHS/tube items are NOT dealt by the company ("SHS நம்ம deal பண்றது இல்ல sir").

## Real rates & terms (only rates that actually appear in the calls)

Rates are quoted **per kg, basic + GST + loading + transport extra** almost everywhere. Sample figures actually stated:

- MS round/ISMB: "65 range தான் 65, 66, 67" ; Vizag MS round ₹68.
- Steel sheet (8mm, 2500mm): quoted ₹65.5/kg, later negotiated "65, 50 அதுல தான் குறைப்பீங்களா?"
- TMT: ₹69 (12mm), ₹68.5 (16mm) "plus GST extra extra" (Saveetha Institute call) — discount limited to ~₹0.5/kg ("16mm வந்து 500 கிடைக்கும்" i.e. ₹0.5 reduction only).
- TMT Chennai base: "63.5 சொல்றது, ஒரு 64 சொல்றது" vs Vizag ₹62 (Vijaya Steels Vizag call) — shows a ~₹1.5-2 city premium over mill-gate.
- Flat steel (negotiation, V Kumar call): opening ₹54, then "535 final" i.e. ₹53.50, firmly refused to go lower — "அவ்ளோ கம்மி நம்மளால கண்டிப்பா பண்ண முடியாது."
- Plate rate drift across weeks (Vinayaga Steel Pradeep thread): ₹59.5k→₹61→₹62→₹63→₹64 per ton equivalent, tracking market increases; rep flags "rate increase ஆயிடுச்சு sir ₹1000 கிட்ட."
- MS Plate 6mm (V R Atmos/Earth Movers): ₹66–₹67/kg + GST + loading + transport extra.
- Structural ISMB (V R Earth Movers): "300,140" vs "300,150" sections — ₹60 vs ₹63/kg depending on section weight/flange; rep explains weight/kg difference (42 vs 46 kg/m) to justify price gap.
- Checkered/plate bulk deal (Zetwork Harish): opening offer then "₹500 கம்மி பண்ணிருக்கேன்... 63.5" — revised down by ₹500 flat per ton style adjustment after push.
- Payment/transport charges: "payment charges ₹200" standard, one-off mistake billed ₹250, resolved via debit/credit note; transport "₹1200 per ton" mentioned with 14-ton minimum; local trailer transport "₹15,000" for 40ft.
- Credit terms: one customer told "credit-ல close ஆயிடுச்சு... 1 month தான்" credit period, with slightly higher price vs advance payment.
- Validity: quotes typically valid ~2 days ("validity 2 days அப்படின்னு சொல்லிருக்காங்க").

General commercial pattern: **Basic rate + GST + loading + transport, all extra**, rates revised almost daily/weekly with market, discounts rarely exceed ₹0.50–₹1/kg or a flat ₹500/ton, and reps consistently push back hard on bigger asks ("correct-ஆ இருக்கு rate... கோச்சுக்காதீங்க").

## Objection Playbook

**1. "Rate குறைக்க முடியுமா?" (Can you reduce the rate?)**
- Standard response: hold firm, cite market increase. "rate increase ஆக போகுது... validity 2 days." Offer only token movement (₹0.5–₹1/kg or small flat amount), never match competitor ask.
- When pushed hard (VASUDEVAN K call): rep refuses repeatedly — "correct சார்... increase பண்ணி கொடுத்துட்டு கம்மி பண்றது எல்லாம் பண்ண மாட்டோம்."

**2. "Grade/brand correctness" (500D vs 550D, Vizag vs SAIL tag mismatch)**
- Reps proactively clarify grade differences and explain MTC/tag documentation requirements to build trust before dispatch — "SAIL tag வந்துருக்கா Vizag tag வந்திருக்கா... material Vizag ஏத்திருக்கு."
- When tag/MTC mismatches occur, resolve via endorsement + reissuing documents rather than disputing shipment.

**3. "Stock not available in required thickness/size"**
- Honest redirection to alternates: "2.5-ல கிடைக்காது... local brand-ல கிடைக்கும்" or offering a different but close size with price justification (weight/flange logic).

**4. Transport/payment-charges disputes**
- Long-time customer anger over inconsistent payment/handling charges (V R Earth Movers "₹250 vs usual ₹200") — resolved by issuing debit/credit note and promising standardization, while firmly refusing to waive compulsory charges.

**5. "Why is this item costlier than before?" / bulk vs regular buyer comparison**
- Reps explain using technical specifics (weight per meter, section dimension, coil vs cut-length) rather than just saying "market is up" — builds credibility.

**6. Urgency/limited stock advice (proactive, not objection but trust-building)**
- One rep genuinely advised a repeat customer to buy limited quantity only, not stockpile, because rates might correct down — "ரொம்ப வாங்காதீங்க... Suppose உங்களுக்கு ஒரு 5 ton ஆட்டு இருந்தா அது மட்டும் வாங்குங்க." This is a strong relationship-building technique distilled from Vasanth Narasimhan Engg call.

## Effective Lines (openings, discovery, closing, follow-up)

**Openings (Tamil, polite, identify company & purpose quickly):**
- "Hello sir, Good Afternoon Sir... group-ல நீங்க 20 mm sale CRS போட்டுருக்கீங்கல்ல?" [You posted 20mm sale CRS in the group?] — references group/WhatsApp rate broadcast, shows multi-channel prospecting.
- "Sir, Good morning Sir. இது ஆயிருக்கா sir, இந்த TMT." — short, direct follow-up on a prior quote.

**Discovery questions used well:**
- "என்ன brand தேவைப்படுது உங்களுக்கு?" [Which brand do you need?]
- "என்ன job work-க்காக use பண்றீங்க sir?" [What fabrication use is this for?] — used to qualify quantity/urgency (Yuvaraj Elumalai call).
